transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I just feel down almost all the time. Most days, I wake up and it already feels like there's this heavy, gray weight sitting right on my chest. Even when I'm at work with the landscaping crew, or, you know, at home around my kids... I just can't shake it. It's this low, hollow feeling, like I'm just going through the motions of the day without really being there.
How long have you been feeling this way most days? Has it been at least two weeks, or has it been going on longer than that?

It's been a lot longer than two weeks. I'd say it's been going on for about three years and three months now. It started right around the time the groundskeeping contract changed at work. They shifted our schedule, and the longer days just completely took over my life. I've been feeling like this ever since.
Have you noticed that you no longer enjoy things that used to make you happy, like hobbies, time with family, or activities you used to look forward to?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I still like seeing my kids, and I still don't mind working on my truck when I have the time. It's not that I don't enjoy those things anymore... it's just that I always have that heavy feeling while I'm doing them. So I still like my hobbies and my family, I just feel down all the time regardless.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels or do you feel unusually tired these days, even after getting enough rest?

Yeah, I have. I'm just... I'm tired all the time. By midmorning, my body already feels like I've put in a full day of work. And it doesn't seem to matter how much rest I get, really. Even after sleeping in on a Sunday, I still just drag through the simplest things. You know, just loading up my tools, checking the job plans for the week, or even just making dinner for the kids... it all just feels like it takes everything I've got. I'm just wiped out.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities, even ones you used to enjoy?

I think we just talked about that a minute ago. Like I said, I still enjoy things. I still like seeing my kids and working on my truck. It's not that I've lost interest, it's just that I always feel down while I'm doing those things.
Have you noticed yourself doing things more slowly than usual, or feeling like it's hard to get motivated to do even simple tasks?

I don't really think so. I haven't noticed myself moving any slower than normal, anyway. I still get out to my job sites and get the landscaping done, and I know what I have to do for the kids. The motivation is there, I guess... I just push through it. Like I was saying a minute ago, it just takes all my energy to actually do it. But no, I wouldn't say I'm moving in slow motion or anything like that.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty, maybe even beating yourself up over things that wouldn’t have bothered you as much before?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't feel worthless, and I'm not really beating myself up over things. I mean, I know I'm a good dad and I do good work at my job. It's just... I just feel low all the time. But it's not because I feel guilty or anything like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating a lot more or a lot less than usual?
No, my appetite's been pretty much the same. I haven't noticed any weight changes either. I still eat my regular meals, it's just... normal, I guess. Nothing's really changed there.
Have you had any problems with your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up in the middle of the night, or sleeping too much?

No, I haven't really had any issues there. I sleep fine, honestly. Being out on the job sites all day, doing all that physical work... by the time night rolls around, I'm pretty beat. So I don't have trouble falling asleep or anything. I just sleep my normal hours and get up when the alarm goes off.
Have you ever felt like life isn't worth living, or had thoughts about harming yourself?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, I feel down, like I said, but... I don't want to hurt myself or anything. I know life is worth living, I've got my kids and all. It's just... it's just been a real slog lately, getting through the days. But no, never any thoughts about ending it.
Have you ever noticed yourself feeling restless, fidgety, or unable to sit still, or on the flip side, feeling like your thoughts or movements have slowed down significantly?

No, I can't say I have. I'm not really the fidgety type, and I haven't noticed myself moving any slower than usual. Like I said, I'm doing physical work all day, so my body's just doing what it needs to do. I haven't felt restless or anything like that. Just... tired, but physically, everything's pretty much the same.
Have you experienced any major stress, trauma, or difficult life events in the past year that have affected you emotionally?

No, not really. I mean, nothing major like a trauma or anything. Just the usual day-to-day stuff, you know? Work can get stressful sometimes, especially when the weather doesn't cooperate and we get behind on jobs, but... nothing out of the ordinary. Just the regular grind.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure or feel less enjoyment from activities that you used to find satisfying, even if you still technically like them?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I still like the things I usually do. Watching the game on Sunday, or just hanging out with the kids... I still enjoy all that just fine. 

Like I said, I'm usually pretty beat from work, so maybe I don't have the energy to do as much as I used to, but... when I do, I still get the same kick out of it. So no, I wouldn't say I've lost any enjoyment.
Has there ever been a time when your mood was so low that it felt like you couldn't go on, even for a brief period?

Well... I don't know about not being able to go on, like quitting everything completely. But it definitely gets really low. I just keep telling myself that this is just how my life is now. It feels like no matter how hard I work, or how much I try to get back to doing things like my own garden at home or going to those music nights... nothing is really going to turn around. It just feels like this is it, and it's not going to get any better.
Can you think of a specific time recently when you felt a clear sense of enjoyment or pleasure doing something, even something small?

Well... yeah, I guess so. Like I mentioned, I still enjoy watching the football game on Sundays. Just this past weekend, my team actually pulled off a win in the last few minutes, and I definitely felt good about that. Or even just sitting down with a cold beer after a really long, hot day at work... that still feels pretty good. So, yeah, I still get enjoyment out of things like that.
Can you recall if there have been any periods lasting at least two weeks where you felt completely back to normal, where the heavy, low feeling wasn’t present at all?

No... no, definitely not. I mean, I have good moments, like I mentioned with the football game or just having a beer, but... a whole two weeks of feeling totally normal? No. 

That heavy feeling is pretty much always there. Even on a decent day, it's just kind of sitting there in the background. I can't remember the last time it actually went away for a couple of weeks straight.
Have you ever had a period where your mood was unusually high or you felt extremely energetic, where you were more talkative than usual, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts were racing?

No, I've never felt anything like that. I'm definitely not the energetic type, and I've never had a time where I couldn't sleep because my mind was going too fast or anything. I'm usually just tired. So, no, nothing like that at all.
Do you tend to wake up earlier than you'd like, or feel like your mood is worse in the morning compared to the rest of the day?

No, not really. I mean, I usually wake up pretty early anyway because of my job—I do landscaping, so I'm up with the sun. But I wouldn't say I wake up earlier than I want to, or that I feel worse in the morning. It's just... that same heavy feeling is there when I wake up, and it stays pretty much the same all day. It doesn't really change depending on the time.
Can you recall if there has ever been a time in the past when you felt completely free of this low mood for at least two months straight?

No, definitely not. I mean, if I haven't even had two weeks where it completely went away, I definitely haven't had two whole months. It's just... it's always there. I honestly can't remember any time in the past where I had a solid couple of months of feeling normal. It's just been this way for a long time.
